definitions.map_target: mean interaction squared over contexts and four covers
definitions.predictor_freeze: all confirmation predictor maps and ranked supports use discovery values with no confirmation calibration
definitions.query_efficiency: singleton outer support rankings need only endpoint effects; their reported map R2 scale uses one alpha fitted on the full discovery map. Row/column, SVD, and raw support rankings require the full pair atlas
definitions.residual_analysis: descriptive split-local nuisance removal; discovery absolute-residual support is evaluated on squared confirmation residual

posthoc_reachability.warning: Confirmation-local factor fit is descriptive, not cross-split prediction.

estimands.critical_e32_4_denominator_warning: within_core_fallback uses induced-core normalization and explicitly is not used for primary gates; primary all-U normalization must be used in paper claims.
estimands.direct_wiring_scope: Official InterpBench edges projected to whole heads/MLPs or Q/K/V fine coordinates; not exhaustive ground truth for arbitrary trained transformers.
estimands.e31_response: Unclipped endpoint-normalized donor-minus-base next-token logit-margin shift.
estimands.e32_response: Class-centered output logits at non-BOS positions; fixed benchmark class vector, not vocabulary KL.
estimands.gap_definition: g=Yclean-Yallcorrupt; allcorrupt patches every internal node/edge in the declared U. Inputs/embeddings are boundary conditions.
estimands.pair_energy: Mean J_ij^2 across contexts, backgrounds, positions/classes where applicable; square before averaging.

source_policy: Immutable local scores. No model loading or inference. Original verdicts retained.
